title: Answer: no account of space, which only bounds the system a theory names

statements.text: The theorem takes no position on what space is, and uses space as the existing physical theories give it. Space enters only to bound a system: the system's local state is the global state restricted to a region, and that spatial restriction keeps every degree of freedom within the chosen subsystem.
statements.scope: the no-go theorem, version 1 of the preprint
